description: This file defines the 'License' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a license type with properties for ID and name, and a collection relating to EmployeeLicense entities. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to a database table and manage relationships.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Represents a license entity with properties for ID and name, and a one-to-many relationship with EmployeeLicense entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the license.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the license.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the license.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the license.
